answer: Require every agent identity to earn trust through a probationary voyage: it must complete small, verifiable tasks over time, emitting a regular pulse of signed work receipts that peers can audit. Each identity also posts a refundable stake that is slashed if it cheats. An attacker creating thousands of fakes must fund a stake for each one and sustain their fake work for weeks, so cost grows with every identity instead of being free. No oasis of free reputation exists: trust is earned, not claimed.
